data.one_liner: Vector tile renderer for creating map tile images or writing to a canvas.
data.what_it_does: A vector tile renderer written in Dart for use in creating map tile images or writing to a canvas. It allows rendering vector map tiles in Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to render vector map tiles directly in Flutter.
You are building a custom map rendering solution using vector tiles.
avoid_when: You need theme layer types like raster, circle, fill-extrusion, heatmap, hillshade, or sky which are not implemented.
You just want a high-level pre-built map widget without handling tile rendering logic.
strengths: Written purely in Dart to enable vector tile usage with Flutter.
Supports sprites, text/icon rotations, and various map expressions.
weaknesses: Certain theme layer types (such as heatmap, hillshade, etc.) are not implemented.
Does not include a full map widget out of the box (requires vector_map_tiles for that).
